name: nrfx_periph
description: nrfx_spim, nrfx_twim, nrfx_pwm and nrfx_saadc on the DK. SPIM2 (4 MHz, mode 0, the driver's CS on D10) to a 25LC040: WREN sets its latch, WRITE of six bytes, RDSR polled through its 5 ms write cycle, READ returns them; 1247 bytes, 16 SCK edges each, after SCK's one from Z to its idle 0 as nrfx configures it. TWIM0 (400 kHz, 4.7 kOhm pull-ups) to a 24C02 at 0x50: a page write, address-only writes NACKed through the write cycle, TXRX (a repeated START by LASTTX_STARTRX), a write without STOP (suspended by LASTTX_SUSPEND) then a read after a repeated START, and 0x51 answered by nobody (ERRORSRC.ANACK, nrfx's -EFAULT); 2346 SCL edges, every START, byte and STOP of it. PWM0 looping one sequence of individual values: OUT1 (D5) at 1 kHz exactly, OUT0 (D3) at 25 % through a 10 kOhm, 4.7 uF low-pass into AIN1. The SAADC after offset calibration, 12 bits, gain 1/6, the 0.6 V reference: AIN2's 1.0 V source floor(1.0 / 6 / 0.6 * 4096) = 1137, VDD's 3.0 V 3413, the low-pass charging to a quarter of VDD.

expect.contains: spim: status 02 after WREN, write cycle over after 614 polls, read nRF52!

twim: page write 0
twim: ready again after 95 NACKs
twim: txrx 0 TWIM!
twim: tx no stop, rx 0 WIM
twim: 0x51 -14

saadc after 400 ms: rc=859 (755 mV) vin=1137 vdd=3413
done
